options.first_frame: India's map with Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Assam each lit in its own colour, a question mark between them.

options.title: Ek state jo sabse zyada states ko chhoota hai 🗺️
options.first_line: कौन-सा स्टेट सबसे ज़्यादा स्टेट्स को छूता है?

why: Three states every viewer knows, lit on the map, turn the question into a guess made at once that only the rest of the Short can settle, even with the sound off.
